title: Dashboard v2
subtitle: Recorded state and evidence from the shared immutable inventory query.
unavailable: The inventory projection is not available. Check its source in Diagnostics.
boundary: Counts describe returned operational resources, excluding scope containers and role assignments. They are not subscription-wide inventory totals.
partial: Partial projection. Missing records cannot be treated as absent or healthy.
unverified: This projection does not declare observed evidence. Current operating state remains unknown.
stale: Stale snapshot. Recorded state cannot establish current operating state.
provisioningHelp: Recorded provisioning state describes creation or configuration, not running state or health.
inventoryScope: Immutable inventory snapshot aligned with the ontology generation
operationalOnly: Authorization and scope-container records are excluded by the shared query.
mapHelp: One cell is one resource. Hover or focus for details; select to pin. Adjacency is not a dependency.
typeEmpty: No matching types in the received projection.
typeHelp: Select a result to apply. Type counts cover received scope before type/state filters.
pageBoundary: Bounded server pages share one generation and cutoff. Local pages and filters do not create observations or authority.
emptyBody: No received record matches these filters. This does not prove absence outside the projection.
pinned: {name} details pinned. Map position is unchanged.
outside: This resource is outside the current filters or displayed page. Its snapshot identity is unchanged.
operationHelp: Values are recorded operational states, including Online, Active, and Enabled. They are not current health verdicts. Provisioning is a separate axis.
availabilityHelp: Only explicitly recorded availability is shown. Missing availability never becomes healthy because another state is Running or Succeeded.
observationHelp: Freshness describes the operational fact's retained evidence. Unknown freshness is distinct from a missing recorded value.
checkHelp: Up to three unknown or transitional records in this projection. Not an incident queue or severity ranking.
noHighlights: No matching highlights. This is not an all-clear verdict.
historyUnavailable: Not included. Use the resource evidence view for recorded history.
missingProvenance: Snapshot identity or observation provenance is missing. The reported status is retained, but current operating state is not established.
oldSnapshot: Snapshot freshness does not establish current state. The last reported status is retained below.
pendingChanges: Unreconciled change records prevent a current operating-state claim.
noState: The inventory source did not supply an operating state for this resource.
resourceTypeUnclassified: The provider resource type has no canonical ResourceType mapping.
stateNotRecorded: No operational value was recorded. Applicability, provider support, and collection coverage remain unresolved.
stateSourceNotRecorded: This ResourceType has a reviewed operational source path, but no value was recorded in this snapshot.
stateApplicabilityUnknown: The ResourceType contract does not yet establish whether operational state applies.
stateMetadataNotRecorded: The operational value was retained without property-level observation metadata.
stateMetadataInvalid: The retained operational metadata is malformed or internally inconsistent.
stateAfterCutoff: The operational timestamp is later than the snapshot cutoff and cannot establish current evidence.
noneRecorded: No Unknown operational records in this snapshot.
unclassifiedState: The source status is not a classified start/stop state. It is retained without treating it as running or healthy.
pending: {count} pending change records; not verified effects
readOnly: Read-only inspection. Filters and selection never authorize changes.
